privacy.title: Privacy Policy - Semaninha
privacy.intro: Your data is collected only for collage generation and is not stored on any server. The site uses the Last.FM API to fetch user data and most listened albums.

privacy.noSharing: Form data (username, period, size and display preferences) is not shared with third parties beyond querying the Last.fm API.

howToUse.title: How to use semaninha
howToUse.intro: semaninha builds collages of what you listened to the most, using your Last.fm history. For that, you need an account there tracking what you listen to.

account.title: Create a Last.fm account
account.text: It's free. Last.fm keeps a history of everything you listen to, and that's where semaninha gets its data.

connect.title: Connect your player
connect.text: Every song you play becomes a "scrobble" on your profile. Spotify connects directly from your Last.fm settings, under Applications. For other players, use apps or browser extensions like Web Scrobbler.

listen.title: Listen to music
listen.text: Last.fm only records from the moment you connect. If your account is new, start with the "Last 7 days" period and a small grid, and go bigger as your history grows.

generate.title: Generate your collage
generate.text: On the home page, enter your Last.fm username (not your Spotify one), pick the period, grid size and type, then click Generate. Then just download the image.

notFound.question: I got "User not found"
notFound.answer: Make sure you entered your Last.fm profile name, exactly as it appears in last.fm/user/your-name.

notEnough.question: It says I don't have enough data
notEnough.answer: You haven't listened to enough different albums or artists to fill the grid in that period yet. Pick a smaller grid or a longer period.

noImage.question: Some covers came out black
noImage.answer: Last.fm has no artwork for those albums, so the tile is filled in black.

support.title: Help keep semaninha online
support.intro: semaninha is free and needs no sign-up, but keeping it online has costs: hosting, the domain and the server that talks to Last.fm. If the site ever made a collage you liked, consider chipping in any amount.
